result.instructions: Tools for Tavzio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still preparing right now?"; "Show the menu items in our Tavzio account."; "Mark order ord_8k2p as ready.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tavzio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tavzio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tavzio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tavzio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tavzio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tavzio_list_resources
tools.title: List API resources
tools.description: List the business's API resources, with whether each is readable, writable or deletable and the scopes it needs. The list is not filtered by this key's scopes: a call without the scope returns 403. Call this first; it returns the current list instead of a fixed one. Tavzio API: GET /api/v1.

tools.name: tavzio_list_records
tools.title: List records of a resource
tools.description: List records of one resource for the business that owns the key (for example orders, menu or tables), paged. Returns data and pagination (limit, offset, total). Tavzio API: GET /api/v1/{resource}.

resource.description: Resource name from tavzio_list_resources, for example orders or menu.

tools.name: tavzio_get_record
tools.title: Get one record
tools.description: Get one record of a resource by id, for example one order with its status and total. Tavzio API: GET /api/v1/{resource}/{id}.

resource.description: Resource name from tavzio_list_resources, for example orders or menu.

id.description: The record id, for example ord_8k2p.

tools.name: tavzio_update_order_status
tools.title: Set order status
tools.description: Move one order to a new status: pending, preparing, ready, completed or cancelled. This uses the same status rules as the Tavzio dashboard and can start kitchen or POS actions. Order creation is not available through this server. Tavzio API: PATCH /api/v1/orders/{id}/status.

order_id.description: The order id, for example ord_8k2p (from tavzio_list_records).
